content: pi0 (openpi, Physical Intelligence): flow-based VLA pre-trained on 10k+ hours robot data. Inference requires >8GB VRAM (fits T4 16GB). LoRA fine-tuning requires >22.5GB. Full fine-tuning >70GB. Ubuntu 22.04 only for raw openpi. HuggingFace LeRobot integration (lerobot/pi0_libero_base) is more portable. Inference API: policy.infer(obs_dict)['actions']. Observations: dict with camera images 224x224 and language prompt. Action space: 7-DOF delta EEF + gripper, chunked. Checkpoints: gs://openpi-assets/checkpoints/pi0_base or lerobot/pi0_libero_base on HuggingFace. pi0.5 is the upgraded variant.
